contact.title: CEO & Founder
contact.notes: Primary target. Founder CEO of smaller studio. Based in Slovenia. Virtual pet/kids games niche. May be open to tools that help them compete with larger studios.

outreach_packet.hook: Building beloved virtual pet games for kids is a special niche—Bubbu and Duddu have created safe, engaging experiences that parents trust.
body_paragraphs: Bubadu has carved out a meaningful space in the kids' games market with 100M+ downloads. But competing against bigger studios with larger live ops teams is tough. You need the same optimization capabilities they have, without the same headcount.

We built an AI live operations platform that levels the playing field for smaller studios. It automates event optimization, personalizes in-app purchase timing, and predicts which content updates will resonate—all without requiring a data science team. One indie studio using our system increased revenue 34% while keeping their team lean.
For Bubadu's virtual pet games, this could mean better monetization while maintaining the safe, trusted experience parents expect. Our platform is designed to be set up in days, not months.
outreach_packet.cta: Worth a quick call to see if AI live ops could help Bubadu grow?

angle_notes.why_this_works: Bubadu is smaller (25 employees) competing in a niche against bigger players. Positioning AI as a force multiplier that lets them compete with larger studios' live ops capabilities is compelling. Founder CEO means direct decision-making possible.
angle_notes.personalization_trigger: Small indie studio + kids games niche
